giver.name: Quartermaster Ines Varga
giver.title: The Pole Beacon outpost
giver.line: Fliers and diggers welcome. The moon gives you enough to build a small ship and not a scrap more; anything bigger is made of what is out there, in the asteroids and what is left of the broken moons. Do me a job and the work will teach you something.

contracts.title: A ship that flies
contracts.description: Bring a ship with every block of its design placed and park it at the outpost, within 40 m of the beacon.

contracts.title: Iron for the beacon
contracts.description: Refine iron aboard a prospector and hand 1 m³ of it over from the ship's hold, parked within 40 m of the beacon.

contracts.title: Cobalt for the shipyard
contracts.description: The moon has no cobalt. Fly out to an asteroid, dig its blue-grey ore, load it into a ship's hold and bring 2 m³ back to the beacon. The shipyard then builds you a hauler's frame.

contracts.title: A proper haul
contracts.description: The outpost is building. Bring 12 m³ of ore in one trip, more than a prospector's hold carries: you will need a hauler.

contracts.title: Rock for the landing pads
contracts.description: Job board, any time: bring 3 m³ of rock in a ship's hold. The outpost always needs more pad.

contracts.title: An ore run
contracts.description: Job board, any time: bring 8 m³ of asteroid ore in one trip, more than a prospector's hold carries.

contracts.title: Bulk ore for the smelter
contracts.description: Job board, for pilots of Trade 2: bring 30 m³ of ore in one trip, a hauler nearly full.

contracts.title: Ore for the new station
contracts.description: Job board, for pilots of Trade 3: bring 50 m³ of ore in one trip. Only a freighter carries it.

contracts.title: Ore for the refinery
contracts.description: Job board, for pilots of Trade 4: bring 100 m³ of ore in one trip. Only an ore barge carries it, and only with ion thruster kits fitted.

contracts.title: A ship that can jump
contracts.description: The quartermaster wants proof the old drives can be made to work again: bring a ship with a jump drive fitted, its hold carrying 2 m³ of iron for the farm on the green planet.
